text: TemporaryCacheMap stores a header and schedules deletion after 60 seconds. Its override does not return this like Map.set, and it does not cancel an older deletion timer when a key is replaced. The removal handler uses it as a short-lived bridge for a later move event. Manual API proposal: document expiry and return semantics and inspect replacement behavior before reusing this class as a general Map substitute. This batch does not establish that replacement causes a real message loss. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Describe the temporary header cache as expiring storage with a limited contract
